sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: For travelers, Gọi khách sạn giúp tôi is the phrase to keep ready for "Please call the hotel for me" in lost items, help, managers, and recovery moments. This is for when you need local help contacting your hotel fast. This is a high-value second sentence once the problem involves a room, booking, or bag. It works best when you focus on putting the need first and leaving room for the helper to confirm the detail. After you say it, listen for a confirmation, a handoff, a price, or a follow-up question; the next rows help you keep the exchange moving.

sections.title: The standard way
sections.body: Use Gọi khách sạn giúp tôi as your first sentence for "Please call the hotel for me". This is for when you need local help contacting your hotel fast. Leave a short pause after the phrase so the other person can answer with a confirmation, a handoff, a price, or a follow-up question. Keep a receipt, room number, ride detail, or last location visible when it helps staff trace the problem.
